name: Universal Orlando Resort
lead: Universal Orlando has eleven on-site hotels in three categories. Every hotel guest gets Early Park Admission, and the top-tier hotels add perks like free Universal Express Unlimited.
benefits: Early Park Admission up to an hour before opening at select attractions. Valid park admission is required.
Free transportation by shuttle bus or water taxi from select hotels, plus walking paths.
Charge purchases to your room key across the parks, hotels and CityWalk.
Free delivery of purchases from select park stores to your hotel (not on check-out day).
benefitsNote: Universal Express Unlimited is included only at Loews Portofino Bay, Hard Rock Hotel and Loews Royal Pacific. It works at select rides at Universal Studios Florida and Islands of Adventure, not at Volcano Bay or Epic Universe.

tiers.name: Signature Collection
tiers.blurb: The top tier. Three of these hotels include free Universal Express Unlimited, and four have water taxis to the parks.

tiers.name: Prime Value
tiers.blurb: Mid-priced hotels with modern style. Stella Nova has a walking path to Epic Universe.

tiers.name: Value Inns & Suites
tiers.blurb: The lowest-priced on-site hotels, with family suites at several of them.

fineprint: Prices, perks and transportation change. We checked Universal's and Loews' benefit pages in November 2026; confirm details with Universal before you book.

hotels.name: Loews Portofino Bay Hotel
hotels.theme: An Italian seaside village by the water, modeled on the town of Portofino.
transport: Water taxi to Universal Studios Florida and Islands of Adventure

guide.overview: Portofino Bay recreates an Italian harbor town, with pastel buildings around a bay. It's one of three hotels that include free Universal Express Unlimited.
guide.suits: Families and couples who want the full set of perks and a quieter, more elegant setting.
cons: Among the most expensive hotels at Universal
Express doesn't cover Volcano Bay or Epic Universe
guide.bestFor: Guests who want Express Unlimited and a calmer stay.
tips: Take the water taxi at least once; it's the most scenic way in.
Link your reservation in the app and check in online so your Express pass appears.
perks: Free Universal Express Unlimited for everyone in the room (select rides at Universal Studios Florida and Islands of Adventure)
Priority seating at select restaurants, booked through the concierge

hotels.name: Hard Rock Hotel
hotels.theme: A music-themed hotel filled with rock memorabilia, closest of the Signature hotels to the main parks.
transport: A short walk to Universal Studios Florida, Islands of Adventure and CityWalk

guide.overview: The Hard Rock Hotel leans into rock-and-roll, with music memorabilia around the property. It's a quick walk to the parks and includes free Universal Express Unlimited.
guide.suits: Groups and families who want to walk to the parks and get Express Unlimited.
pros: A quick walk to the parks
cons: Not the place for a quiet, low-key stay
guide.bestFor: Thrill fans who want to walk to the rides.
tips: Walking is often faster than the water taxi from here.
Link your reservation and check in online so your Express pass shows up in the app.
perks: Free Universal Express Unlimited for everyone in the room (select rides at Universal Studios Florida and Islands of Adventure)
Priority seating at select restaurants, booked through the concierge

hotels.name: Loews Royal Pacific Resort
hotels.theme: A South Pacific island escape with lush, tropical grounds.
transport: Water taxi to Universal Studios Florida and Islands of Adventure

guide.overview: Royal Pacific has a South Seas, tropical look. It's the third hotel that includes free Universal Express Unlimited, and it's often the lowest-priced of those three. That price point is our general read, so check current rates.
guide.suits: Families who want Express Unlimited at the best value they can find.
cons: A longer walk than the Hard Rock
guide.bestFor: Families who want Express without the highest price.
perks: Free Universal Express Unlimited for everyone in the room (select rides at Universal Studios Florida and Islands of Adventure)
Priority seating at select restaurants, booked through the concierge

hotels.name: Loews Sapphire Falls Resort
hotels.theme: A Caribbean island resort built around waterfalls and a lagoon.
transport: Water taxi to Universal Studios Florida and Islands of Adventure

guide.overview: Sapphire Falls has a Caribbean theme with waterfalls and a lagoon. It's in the Signature Collection but doesn't include Express Unlimited, which usually makes it cheaper than the three hotels that do.
guide.suits: Families who want a Signature-level hotel and water taxi but don't need Express.
pros: Lower price than the Express hotels
guide.bestFor: Families who want a nicer hotel without paying for Express.

hotels.name: Universal Helios Grand Hotel, a Loews Hotel
hotels.theme: A celestial-themed grand hotel inside Epic Universe, with its own entrance into the park.
transport: Dedicated entrance into Epic Universe (park admission required)

guide.overview: Helios Grand is the only hotel with its own entrance into Epic Universe. It doesn't include Express Unlimited, and Express isn't valid at Epic Universe anyway.
guide.suits: Fans planning several days at Epic Universe who want to come and go easily.
pros: Its own entrance into Epic Universe
Easy midday breaks during an Epic day
cons: Far from the original two parks

hotels.name: Universal Aventura Hotel
hotels.theme: A sleek, modern high-rise with a rooftop bar.
transport: Walking path to Volcano Bay (closed seasonally)
Shuttle bus or a walk to the Sapphire Falls water taxi

guide.overview: Aventura is a modern, minimalist hotel with a rooftop bar, Bar 17. It's walking distance to Volcano Bay, and guests can walk over to Sapphire Falls to catch the water taxi.
guide.suits: Couples and smaller families who want a stylish room at a mid-range price.
pros: Modern rooms and a rooftop bar
cons: Fewer resort-style amenities than the bigger hotels

hotels.name: Universal Stella Nova Resort
hotels.theme: A space-age hotel inspired by the stars and constellations, next to Epic Universe. Opened in 2025.
transport: Walking path to Epic Universe (park admission required)

guide.overview: Stella Nova opened in 2025 next to Epic Universe, with a cosmic, futuristic theme. Universal lists a walking path straight to Epic Universe.
guide.suits: Families who want to walk to Epic Universe at a mid-range price.
cons: Farther from the original two parks

hotels.name: Universal Terra Luna Resort
hotels.theme: Stella Nova's twin, with a bright, otherworldly look near Epic Universe.
transport: Resort transportation (check Universal for current options)

guide.overview: Terra Luna is the companion hotel to Stella Nova near Epic Universe. Universal doesn't list the same walking path to Epic for Terra Luna, so check how you'll get to the parks.
guide.suits: Families who want a newer mid-range hotel near Epic Universe.
cons: No Epic Universe walking path listed

hotels.name: Universal Cabana Bay Beach Resort
hotels.theme: A retro 1950s and 1960s beach-motel look, with family suites and plenty to do.
transport: Walking path to Volcano Bay (closed seasonally)
Shuttle bus to the parks (check current routes)

guide.overview: Cabana Bay has a retro mid-century look. It has two pools, a lazy river and a bowling alley, and Volcano Bay is a short walk away.
guide.suits: Families on a budget who want lots to do at the hotel.
pros: Two pools and a lazy river

hotels.name: Universal Endless Summer Resort – Surfside Inn and Suites
hotels.theme: A laid-back surf and beach theme at one of Universal's lowest prices.
transport: Resort transportation (check Universal for current options)

guide.overview: Surfside is one half of the Endless Summer Resort, with a beachy, surf-town theme. It's one of the lowest-priced ways to stay on site and still get Early Park Admission.
guide.suits: Families who want the on-site perks at the lowest price.
cons: Farther from the parks than most hotels

hotels.name: Universal Endless Summer Resort – Dockside Inn and Suites
hotels.theme: Surfside's sister hotel, with the same beachy theme and value pricing.
transport: Resort transportation (check Universal for current options)

guide.overview: Dockside is the other half of the Endless Summer Resort. Like Surfside, it's one of the cheapest on-site options and comes with Early Park Admission.
guide.suits: Families who want to stay on site for less.
cons: Farther from the parks than most hotels
